message: We all know how important it is to be prepared for whatever life throws our way, right? 🤔 It’s those ‘I told you so’ moments that remind us of the value of planning ahead. This guide from Ready.gov offers straightforward steps to help us create a family emergency plan. Let’s take a moment to reflect on what our own plans look like and maybe even tweak them a bit. After all, a little preparation can go a long way in keeping our loved ones safe and sound.
